app.title: Hi-Fi Bridge – Flash tool
board.title: Which Raspberry Pi will become your Hi-Fi Bridge?
board.intro: Each board needs its own image. The image is checked against this choice before anything is written.
board.rpizero2w.desc: Smallest and most frugal. Bluetooth and Wi-Fi share one 2.4 GHz radio.
board.rpi3.desc: The reference board of the project. Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and Ethernet on board.
board.rpi4.desc: The most powerful option, with Gigabit Ethernet.
board.note: The images are configured for these boards. Operation on real hardware is confirmed only after the hardware tests.
image.title: Choose the system image
image.intro: Official images come from the project's releases. Every image is verified with its signed manifest before it can be written.
image.loaded: {count} image(s) for this board. Choose one.
image.none_for_board: The source has no image for this board. Use your own image or another source (Settings).
image.ok.official: Verified: version {version}, signed by the official publisher “{publisher}” ({fingerprint}).
image.ok.custom: Verified: version {version}, signed by the CUSTOM publisher “{publisher}” ({fingerprint}) that you added yourself. This is not an official image.
src.err.unreachable: The release source cannot be reached. Check the internet connection or use your own image.
src.err.not_found_or_private: The release source was not found or is private (the project repository is not public yet). Use your own image or set another source in Settings.
src.err.http_error: The release source answered with an error.
src.err.bad_response: The release source sent an answer that could not be read.
src.err.bad_url: The release source is not a valid http(s) address. Check it in Settings.
img.err.unsigned: The image has no signature. Unsigned images are never written.
img.err.untrusted_signature: The signature is not from a trusted publisher. For a self-built image, add its publisher key in Settings – only if you trust it.
img.err.wrong_board: This image is for another board.
img.err.hash_mismatch: The image does not match its signed manifest (damaged or modified). It will not be written.
img.err.size_mismatch: The image has a different size than its signed manifest. It will not be written.
img.err.unreadable: The image or one of its files cannot be read.
img.err.cancelled: Cancelled. A started download continues next time.
disk.title: Choose the SD card
disk.intro: Only removable cards and sticks are offered. Everything on the chosen card will be erased.
disk.large: Also allow unusually large disks (over 256 GB)
disk.none: No suitable card found. Insert an SD card (at least 2 GB; 16 GB recommended) and press Refresh.
disk.mounted: Its mounted volumes ({mounts}) will be unmounted before writing.
disk.reason.in_use_by_volume_manager: in use by an encrypted or LVM volume
disk.reason.unusually_large_confirm_expl: unusually large (allow it above if this really is the card)
prov.title: Set up this device
prov.intro: These settings are written to the card for the first start. A new setup code and a new trust key are created for every card.
prov.name: Device name (optional)
prov.hotspot: Setup hotspot if no network is available
prov.hs_psk: Own hotspot password (optional, at least 12 characters)
prov.note: Without Wi-Fi the device uses Ethernet. The setup hotspot only opens with the individual password on your owner sheet.
prov.err.name: Not allowed as a device name.
prov.err.host: Use letters, digits and hyphens (for example: living-room).
prov.err.country: Choose the country where the device is used.
confirm.title: Check and confirm
confirm.intro: Writing needs administrator rights once; your system will ask for them.
confirm.type: To confirm, type the card's name: {name}
write.title: Writing the card
write.intro: Please do not remove the card. If anything goes wrong, the card is made unbootable so it never starts a half-written system.
write.err.bad_request: The write helper refused the request.
write.err.disk_gone: The card is no longer connected. Nothing was written.
write.err.disk_changed: Another card was inserted since you chose it. Nothing was written – choose the card again.
write.err.disk_refused: This drive must not be written. Nothing was written.
write.err.unmount_failed: The card's volumes could not be unmounted. Close windows and programs that use the card, then try again.
write.err.open_failed: The card could not be opened exclusively. Nothing was written.
write.err.image_unreadable: The image file cannot be read.
write.err.internal: The write helper reported an internal error.
write.err.elevation_refused: Administrator permission was not granted (or the write helper is missing). Nothing was written.
write.err.helper_died: The write helper stopped unexpectedly. Do not use the card before writing it again.
write.err.protocol: The write helper does not match this program version.
done.title: The card is ready
done.intro: Written and verified. Keep the owner sheet below – the setup code and the hotspot password are not stored anywhere else.
done.next: After the first start, verify the device below so your computer trusts its secure connection.
trust.title: Verify the device (secure connection)
trust.intro: Once the device has started (a few minutes), this computer checks with the secret on the card that the device certificate is genuine, then tests the encrypted connection.
trust.idle: Not verified yet. If you close this program first, compare the fingerprint in hifi-status.txt on the card instead.
trust.bad_address: Enter a host name such as hifi-bridge.local (optionally with :port).
trust.ok: Verified. Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256): {fingerprint}. Install the saved certificate on your devices, or compare this fingerprint when your browser asks.
trust.failed: Not verified – do NOT trust this connection: {detail}
sheet.intro: Keep this sheet. It belongs to exactly one device.
sheet.step.insert: Insert the card into the Raspberry Pi.
sheet.step.power: Connect the power supply (and the network cable, if used). The first start takes a few minutes.
sheet.step.wifi: Open https://{address} on a phone or computer in the same Wi-Fi.
sheet.step.ethernet: Open https://{address} on a device in the same network.
sheet.step.hotspot: If the device does not appear, join the Wi-Fi “{ssid}” with the hotspot password and open http://10.42.0.1.
sheet.step.code: Enter the setup code and choose your owner password.
sheet.step.trust: Verify the device with the flash tool, or compare the fingerprint in hifi-status.txt on the card.
sheet.keep: The setup code becomes invalid as soon as you set the owner password.
settings.title: Settings
settings.source.hint: GitHub Releases API address (or a mirror with the same format). Trust comes from the signature, not from the source.
settings.source.invalid: The release source must be an http(s) address.
settings.keys.none: No trusted publisher yet (the official key is not published yet).
settings.key.name: Name for a new key
settings.key.confirm.title: Trust this publisher?
settings.key.confirm:
Images signed by “{name}” will be accepted and shown as CUSTOM publisher.

Fingerprint (SHA-256):
{fingerprint}

Compare it with the fingerprint from the person who built the images. Trust it?
settings.key.added: “{name}” is now a trusted custom publisher.
settings.key.only_custom: Only custom keys can be removed.
